title: allowissadula microcalyx
intro: Allowissadula microcalyx, commonly known as Mexican desert marigold, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, potentially aiding in wound healing and reducing fever. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, suggesting potential use in treating conditions such as skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of Allowissadula microcalyx include flavonoids, saponins, and triterpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
